definitions.explanation: Waste materials that cannot be incinerated, such as glass, ceramics, and metals. In Japanese garbage sorting, this is one of the main categories alongside burnable waste and recyclables.

examples.japanese: {不燃物|ふねんぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Non-burnable waste is put out on Wednesdays.

examples.japanese: ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧や⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不燃物|ふねんぶつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分類|ぶんるい}される→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧。
examples.english: Glass and ceramics are classified as non-burnable waste.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧{不燃物|ふねんぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I disposed of all the non-burnable waste that came out from moving.

notes:
Compound of {不燃|ふねん} (non-combustible) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing/material).

EXAMPLES OF {不燃物|ふねんぶつ}:
- ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧ (glass)
- ⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧ (ceramics)
- ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧ (metals)
- ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧ (small appliances)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{可燃物|かねんぶつ}→可燃物：16790_kanenbutsu⟧/⟦{燃|も}えるゴミ→燃えるゴミ：17105_moerugomi⟧: burnable waste (opposite)
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧: recyclable waste
- ⟦{粗大|そだい}ゴミ→粗大ゴミ：08045_sodaigomi⟧: oversized waste

ALSO CALLED:
{不燃|ふねん}⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ or ⟦{燃|も}えないゴミ→燃えないゴミ：23525_moenaigomi⟧ in everyday language.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese municipalities have strict garbage sorting rules. {不燃物|ふねんぶつ} collection days vary by area and are typically less frequent than burnable waste days.
